request.query: For an eventually true predicate near zero and positive upper bound a there exists b positive such that [0,b] is in the predicate and b<a

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Filter.Eventually.exists_lt",
      "informal_name": "Existence of Left Neighborhood Element for Eventually True Property",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] {a : α} [(nhdsWithin a (Set.Iio a)).NeBot]\n  {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ b < a, p b",
      "informal_description": "In a topological space equipped with a preorder, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood of a point $ a $, then there exists an element $ b < a $ such that $ p(b) $ is true.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.LeftRight"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Filter.Eventually.exists_gt",
      "informal_name": "Existence of a Greater Element in Neighborhood Filter",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] {a : α} [(nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a)).NeBot]\n  {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ b > a, p b",
      "informal_description": "In a topological space equipped with a preorder, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood filter of a point $ a $, and the filter of neighborhoods strictly greater than $ a $ is non-trivial (i.e., not the bottom filter), then there exists an element $ b > a $ such that $ p(b) $ holds.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.LeftRight"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "eventually_nhdsGT_zero_mul_left",
      "informal_name": "Multiplication by a Positive Element Preserves Eventual Properties in Right Neighborhoods of Zero",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : Field 𝕜] [inst_1 : LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace 𝕜]\n  [OrderTopology 𝕜] {x : 𝕜},\n  0 < x →\n    ∀ {p : 𝕜 → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (ε : 𝕜) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), p ε) → ∀ᶠ (ε : 𝕜) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), p (x * ε)",
      "informal_description": "For any positive element $x$ in an ordered topological field $\\mathbb{K}$, if a property $p$ holds for all sufficiently small positive $\\varepsilon$, then $p$ also holds for all sufficiently small positive $x \\cdot \\varepsilon$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Order.Field"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Filter.Eventually.exists_Ioo_subset",
      "informal_name": "Existence of Open Interval for Eventually Property in Neighborhood",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] [NoMinOrder α]\n  {a : α} {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ l u, a ∈ Set.Ioo l u ∧ Set.Ioo l u ⊆ {x | p x}",
      "informal_description": "In a linearly ordered topological space without maximum or minimum elements, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood of a point $ a $, then there exist elements $ l $ and $ u $ such that $ a $ lies in the open interval $ (l, u) $ and the entire interval is contained within the set $ \\{x \\mid p(x)\\} $. This asserts that eventual truth in a neighborhood implies containment in an open interval.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Filter.Eventually.volume_pos_of_nhds_real",
      "informal_name": "Neighborhood Sets Have Positive Lebesgue Measure",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {p : ℝ → Prop} {a : ℝ}, (∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in nhds a, p x) → 0 < MeasureTheory.volume {x | p x}",
      "informal_description": "If a property $ p $ holds in a neighborhood of a real number $ a $, then the Lebesgue measure of the set $ \\{x \\in \\mathbb{R} \\mid p(x)\\} $ is positive, i.e., $ 0 < \\text{volume}(\\{x \\mid p(x)\\}) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Lebesgue.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "eventually_le_nhds",
      "informal_name": "Eventually Less Than or Equal in Neighborhood Filter",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {a b : α},\n  a < b → ∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, x ≤ b",
      "informal_description": "For any elements $a$ and $b$ such that $a < b$, there exists a neighborhood of $a$ such that for all $x$ in this neighborhood, $x \\leq b$. In other words, the condition $x \\leq b$ holds eventually in the neighborhood filter at $a$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.OrderClosed"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Existence of Left Neighborhood Element for Eventually True Property
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] {a : α} [(nhdsWithin a (Set.Iio a)).NeBot]
  {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ b < a, p b
items.informal_description: In a topological space equipped with a preorder, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood of a point $ a $, then there exists an element $ b < a $ such that $ p(b) $ is true.

items.informal_name: Existence of a Greater Element in Neighborhood Filter
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] {a : α} [(nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a)).NeBot]
  {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ b > a, p b
items.informal_description: In a topological space equipped with a preorder, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood filter of a point $ a $, and the filter of neighborhoods strictly greater than $ a $ is non-trivial (i.e., not the bottom filter), then there exists an element $ b > a $ such that $ p(b) $ holds.

items.informal_name: Multiplication by a Positive Element Preserves Eventual Properties in Right Neighborhoods of Zero
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : Field 𝕜] [inst_1 : LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace 𝕜]
  [OrderTopology 𝕜] {x : 𝕜},
  0 < x →
    ∀ {p : 𝕜 → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (ε : 𝕜) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), p ε) → ∀ᶠ (ε : 𝕜) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), p (x * ε)
items.informal_description: For any positive element $x$ in an ordered topological field $\mathbb{K}$, if a property $p$ holds for all sufficiently small positive $\varepsilon$, then $p$ also holds for all sufficiently small positive $x \cdot \varepsilon$.

items.informal_name: Existence of Open Interval for Eventually Property in Neighborhood
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] [NoMinOrder α]
  {a : α} {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ l u, a ∈ Set.Ioo l u ∧ Set.Ioo l u ⊆ {x | p x}
items.informal_description: In a linearly ordered topological space without maximum or minimum elements, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood of a point $ a $, then there exist elements $ l $ and $ u $ such that $ a $ lies in the open interval $ (l, u) $ and the entire interval is contained within the set $ \{x \mid p(x)\} $. This asserts that eventual truth in a neighborhood implies containment in an open interval.

items.informal_name: Neighborhood Sets Have Positive Lebesgue Measure
items.type: ∀ {p : ℝ → Prop} {a : ℝ}, (∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in nhds a, p x) → 0 < MeasureTheory.volume {x | p x}
items.informal_description: If a property $ p $ holds in a neighborhood of a real number $ a $, then the Lebesgue measure of the set $ \{x \in \mathbb{R} \mid p(x)\} $ is positive, i.e., $ 0 < \text{volume}(\{x \mid p(x)\}) $.

items.informal_name: Eventually Less Than or Equal in Neighborhood Filter
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {a b : α},
  a < b → ∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, x ≤ b
items.informal_description: For any elements $a$ and $b$ such that $a < b$, there exists a neighborhood of $a$ such that for all $x$ in this neighborhood, $x \leq b$. In other words, the condition $x \leq b$ holds eventually in the neighborhood filter at $a$.
